main_text.l: *אספוג vide in ספג.
אספלידא Ch. Spelunca, Exod.33.22. in Jon. Corrupta
vox, ex Græc. σπηλαιον, vel σπηλάδιον.
אספלעיתא, אספלניתא Ch. Splenium, σπληνιον, Empla-
strum, Jobi 30.24.
אספמיא, [illegible, ~6 letters] Hispania.
אספנקי, אספנקי Ch. Zona, cingulum.
[illegible, ~6 letters] Syr. Aspis, ἀσπις, serpentum species, ad
Roman.3.13.
אספסתא Ch. Pabulum, cibus jumentorum.
אספקלטור Ch. [illegible, ~8 letters] Syr. Speculator, satel-
les, carnifex, Mar.6.27. Reperitur & absque א.
אספקלר, אספקלריא, אספקלר Ch. Speculare, speculum.
Plur. אספקלרין Specula, Deut.33.17. in Jon.
אספרנא, אספור, [illegible, ~5 letters] Vide in ספר.
[illegible, ~5 letters] Syr. Σπυρίς, Sporta. Plur. [illegible, ~5 letters].
אספרמקין Ch. Aromata, Pharmaca. A Græco φάρμακον,
Deut.28.23. in Targ. Jonath.
אסק איסקריטין Ch. Tubi, Fistulæ, Zach.4.12. Item
Lagana, Placentæ, Exod.16.31. in Onkelo.
אסקופא vide in סקף.
אסר [illegible, ~3 letters] Ch. & Syr. Ligavit, colligavit, vincivit,
vinxit: Item Ch. Prohibere, vetare. Aphel אסר
Idem. Ithpeh, Chald. אתאסר, Syr. [illegible, ~4 letters] Ligari,
Vinciri.
אסור

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic/Syriac and Greek words are rendered approximately where the scan is too small to read letter by letter; the Syriac and Hebrew forms in the scan are partly illegible and marked accordingly. Printed Aramaic script forms in the entries "Speculator", "Aspis", "Splenium" and "Sporta" could not be fully verified.
